title: packagehistory
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid.

applicationid.description: Unique identifier for the application installed

applicationname.description: The application name of the target for installation

catalogid.description: The catalog that acted as the source for the artifact

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

deploymentlog.description: Stores the package deployment logs for an installation

deploymentmessageid.description: Stores Deployment MessageId for the queued package.

executionname.description: The display name for this operation

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

isclusteroperation.description: Indicates whether this package history record represents a cluster operation

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

packagefile.description: Stores the package file for installation

packagehistoryid.description: Unique identifier for a single package history execution

packageid.description: Unique identifier for the package to install

publishername.description: The publisher name of the target for installation

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the operation

uniquename.description: The unique name of the target for installation

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

version.description: The version of the target for installation

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.
